special_traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
special_traits.description:
If the erinyes dies outside the
Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

special_traits.name: Magic Resistance
special_traits.description:
The erinyes has Advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_traits.name: Magic Rope
special_traits.description: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bear-

special_traits.name: ing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action
special_traits.description: The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The erinyes makes three Withering Sword
attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

actions.name: Withering Sword
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Ne-
crotic damage.

actions.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see

actions.name: within 120 feet
actions.description: Failure: 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a Bonus Action to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll

reactions.name: while holding a weapon
reactions.description: Response: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
